verdicts.reason: NS_GET_USERNS/NS_GET_PARENT and PIDFD_GET_INFO are shown, but no pidfd namespace fetch ioctls (e.g. PIDFD_GET_*_NAMESPACE) are included in the cited fragments.
All six ioctls and constants (SEV_ISSUE_CMD, SNP_GET_REPORT, SNP_GET_DERIVED_KEY, SOCK_DIAG_BY_FAMILY, TEE_IOC_VERSION, TEE_IOC_OPEN_SESSION) match the claim.
Fragments and kernel semantics confirm BUG() panics, ERR_PTR encodes small negative numbers, 1<<9=512, unsafe_get_user needs user_access_begin, ETH_ALEN=6, and input_event size varies.
nfs_stat has discontinuous values, NS_GET_TGID_FROM_PIDNS uses _IOR direction, and tc_u32_sel, sctp_send_failed, and sctp_authkey end with flexible array members requiring bounds.

overall: Findings 6, 7, and 8 are fully supported by the cited fragments and standard kernel invariants; Finding 5 is partial because pidfd namespace query ioctls are omitted from the citations.
